component.name: AI Desktop
component.summary: Ask questions about confidential PDFs, entirely on your computer

description.p: Drop in a PDF, ask a question in plain English, and get an answer with the page numbers it came from. The AI model runs on your own CPU, and the extracted text is stored in an encrypted (SQLCipher) database.

ul.li: No account, no cloud, no telemetry
Answers cite their source pages; click to see the passage
Works offline after a one-time, verified model download (about 1 GB)

screenshot.caption: An answer with clickable page sources

description.p: First release with the Q&A screen: upload a PDF, ask questions, get answers with page sources. Uses Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, downloaded once on first run.
